faqs.question: How can I get a Germany work permit from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Secure a genuine German job or Ausbildung contract, meet language and document rules, then apply for the correct national visa. SK Immigration prepares the file; the German mission decides.

faqs.question: Do I need German language for a work visa?
faqs.answer: Most employers require German (often A2–B1+). Some English-only tech roles exist but are competitive. We map a realistic language plan before you pay fees.

faqs.question: Is Ausbildung different from a work permit?
faqs.answer: Ausbildung is dual vocational training with a training salary and school days. It uses a related visa path. SK covers both — see our Ausbildung pages.

faqs.question: What is SK Immigration’s work permit fee?
faqs.answer: From PKR 80,000 for preparation support. Official embassy and medical fees are separate. No visa outcome guarantees.

faqs.question: Can SK Immigration guarantee a German work visa?
faqs.answer: No. Only German authorities approve visas. We prepare complete, honest files and explain risks clearly.

faqs.question: Which jobs are common for Pakistan applicants?
faqs.answer: Nursing/care Ausbildung, hospitality, mechatronics, logistics, IT and skilled trades — depending on language and employer demand.

body:
Germany work permit / work visa from Pakistan

Germany is one of the strongest legal work pathways from Pakistan: skilled jobs, shortage occupations, and Ausbildung (earn-while-you-train). Success depends on a real employer, correct documents and honest language planning — not “guaranteed visa” agents.

Requirements

  • Valid job offer / employment contract or Ausbildung training contract from a German employer
  • Passport valid 6+ months with blank pages
  • Recognized qualifications or experience matching the role (recognition may apply)
  • German language level matching the job (often A2–B1; nursing/care usually higher)
  • Health insurance and clean civil documents
  • Proof you can enter legally via the correct national visa category

Process

  1. Free consultation — role fit, language and timeline
  2. CV packaging (German-friendly) and document review. A genuine contract comes from an employer — we do not promise placement
  3. Contract / offer review against embassy expectations
  4. Document checklist, attestation and translations
  5. National visa appointment preparation and biometrics
  6. Travel readiness briefing after decision

Documents

  • Passport, photos, completed national visa forms
  • Signed employment or Ausbildung contract
  • CV, certificates, experience letters
  • Language certificates (Goethe / telc / equivalent where required)
  • Degree attestation / recognition papers if requested
  • Insurance and fee receipts

Related checklist tool: Open checklist →

Fees

SK Immigration work-permit support from PKR 80,000 (case-by-case). Embassy visa fees, medicals, translations and flights are separate and paid to official providers.

Timeline

Often 3–8 months from ready contract to visa decision, longer if language training or degree recognition is needed.

Common mistakes

  • Paying agents who invent fake German job offers
  • Applying with language far below the employer’s requirement
  • Submitting untranslated or unattested certificates when asked
  • Confusing tourist/visit entry with work authorization

Germany work routes from Pakistan — pick the right door

“Germany work visa” is not one form. Pakistani applicants usually fall into skilled employment with a recognized qualification, EU Blue Card-type profiles, shortage/occupation-specific routes, or the Ausbildung training path (not the same as a full skilled work permit).

Recognition and Make-it-in-Germany

Many occupations need credential recognition before the mission will treat the file as skilled employment. Start with official guidance on Make it in Germany / German missions — not a Facebook “guarantee employer.”

  • Short tourism → visit visa (cannot work)

Germany work vs Ausbildung vs study — choose correctly

Do not mix pathways. A genuine job offer or Ausbildung contract is the core of most work files. If you only want a degree, use Germany study visa. If you want dual training with a training salary, start with Ausbildung Pakistan.

  • Language plan before you pay VFS (often A2–B1+)
  • Contract authenticity and employer details
  • Document attestation order for the destination
